Bill of materials

What it's built from.

MCU module

ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, Wi-Fi + BLE

Battery

1S Li-ion, 1800 mAh, protected

Charger + gauge

USB-C charging, live battery %

Display

1.54″ colour LCD, 240 × 240, SPI

IMU

6-axis motion sensor, I2C

Microphone

I2S digital mic

Speaker + amp

1 W class-D amplifier

RGB LED ring

10 × addressable LEDs, the halo

Motor driver

Dual H-bridge, 2 DC motors

Servos + expansion

4 servo headers, edge connector, clip pads
